basic_info.description: Step into this tranquil, bright Candlestick Cove townhouse built in 2010, offering the comfort and feel of a single-family home. Featuring 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and a 2-car side-by-side garage, this home offers relaxed, serene living.  The kitchen is a cook's delight, with ample workspace on quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and abundant storage. Elegant flooring, recessed lighting, and in-unit laundry add to the modern convenience and style. Enjoy easy access to Highway 101/280, placing you just minutes from downtown San Francisco. A private shuttle connects you effortlessly to BART and Caltrain, making commuting a breeze.
